spans.s:
(औ) r. 1st cl. औरञ्ज (रजति-ते) 4th cl. (रज्यति-ते)
To dye, to tinge, to give tint or colour to any thing.
r. 1st cl. (रजति)
To be attached to or intent on, to have one's affections or passions engaged by any object.
With अनु prefixed,
To be fond of or attached to.
With अप and वि,
To be averse, to dislike.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 What incites or affects.
2 What colours, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 Colouring, dyeing.
2 A colorist, a painter.
3 A dyer.
4 A stimulus, an inciter of affection, &c.
5 Biliary humour on which vision depends.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, वुन aff.

mn. (-नः-नं)
1 Colouring, dyeing, painting, &c.
2 Affecting the heart, exciting passion, &c.
n. (-नं)
Red Sandal or Sappan wood.
f. (-नी)
1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.)
2 Bengal madder.
3 Another plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, (a species of Crinum?)
4 A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.)
E.
रञ्ज to colour, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Moved or affected.
2 Coloured, dyed, tinted.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, क्त aff.
